answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities. Each agent takes one slot by locking twice 30 days of earnings. A jury checks work: hollow output burns the deposit and bars it 20 epochs, while cedar-solid proof releases it. Fake slots spread like a vine from one graph, so one failure flags the cluster. 100 fakes cost 100 deposits, about 6,000 days of earnings; an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps every reward, while a wander never pays.
